description: Source code for STM32 watchdog driver using Zephyr RTOS, implementing watchdog timer functionalities including setup, timeout configuration, feeding, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_irq_config
methods.description: Configures the interrupt for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_get_pclk
methods.description: Retrieves the peripheral clock frequency for the watchdog.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_get_timeout
methods.description: Calculates the timeout in microseconds based on prescaler and counter.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_convert_timeout
methods.description: Converts a timeout in microseconds to prescaler and counter values.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_setup
methods.description: Initializes and enables the watchdog timer with options.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_disable
methods.description: Attempts to disable the watchdog (not supported).

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_install_timeout
methods.description: Configures the watchdog timeout and callback.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for watchdog events.

methods.name: wwdg_stm32_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device during system startup.
